q: How many holes is Cottonwood Golf Center and what's the par?
a: Nine holes, par 28. The layout runs 1,226 yards from the longest tees with a USGA rating of 22 and slope of 113 — eight par 3s and one par 4 (hole #3).

q: How do I book a tee time — online, by phone, or walk-up?
a: Online tee times are not currently available. Book by calling the pro shop at 951.413.3290, or walk up to the clubhouse at 13671 Frederick Street.
Driving range, putting green, and pitching/chipping area, plus a teaching pro for lessons. Carts and club rentals are available on-site.

q: What are the green fees, and are there senior and youth discounts?
a: Resident rates: weekday adult $11.50 / senior $7.50 / youth $6.25; weekend adult $14 / senior $11.50 / youth $9. Twilight (one hour before dusk) is $7.50 flat. Non-residents pay 30% more. A 10-round punch card is $94.75 adult.

q: Is there a junior golf program?
a: Yes — The First Tee Life Skills Experience Program runs after-school for ages 5-17, built around The First Tee's Nine Core Values. Contact sports@moval.org for details.

q: Can I host a private event here?
a: Yes — the on-site banquet room (~2,275 sq ft) seats up to 125, with a full kitchen, lobby, and a separate smaller room (bride's room). Rentals go through the City at 951.413.3280.

q: Is there disc golf on the property?
a: Yes — Cottonwood also offers a 9-hole disc golf course at the same resident pricing tiers (adult $11.50 weekday / $14 weekend, with senior and youth rates).
